payload.title: Stabilize restored CI on the production Python runtime
payload.description:
Restored GitHub Actions exposed deterministic failures in the production Python job and re-enabled a ruleset synchronization workflow whose administrative token is unavailable. The Python matrix also spends Actions minutes on a non-production runtime.

Expected behavior:
- Pull-request Python validation runs once on the production Python 3.11 runtime.
- The local Helm chart test provisions its repository metadata in an isolated test environment.
- Evaluation item lookup tests patch the supported explicit score resolver.
- Ruleset synchronization remains disabled until supported administrative authentication is available.
- Core CI, documentation, and release workflows remain enabled.
